newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: PRESS DIGEST - Ireland, May 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ireland, May 7.

text.p: The following are the highlights of stories from the Irish press on Wednesday.
IRISH TIMES
- Ryanair flotation to place 300 million punt value on company
- Hepatitis C groups welcome improved compensation deal
- Mobutu to leave Zaire as Kabila calls for army to surrender
- Central Bank returns to prop up the Irish pound
- Tight cost control and revenue growth boosts Ryanair profits
24 percent to 26 million pounds
- Tellabs plans 210 new jobs
- EU asks Irish police to investigate firm which got 3.2 million punts for R&D
- Quinnsworth takeover gets EU clearance
- Brewery group to raise 7.6 million punts through offer
IRISH INDEPENDENT
- Security alert as the Prince of Wales flies in for concert in Belfast
- Sterling shake-up puts new pressure on loan rates
- ERSI backs water meters in new twist to water charges row
- Millionaire Irish prime minister John Bruton tops party leader wealth league
- Aminex to break even soon after reducing net losses
- Other lenders to follow suit as Irish Permanent ups loan rate
- Avonmore still keen on merger with Waterford Foods
- Raise interest rates VAT on heating oil and power - ESRI
